note: Teaches Ann Cavoukian's 7 Foundational Principles of Privacy by Design and their connection to GDPR Article 25. No real product UI applies to this content (it's a design philosophy and a piece of legal text, not a tool screen), so no screenshot is used per SCREENSHOTS.md's documented exception for non-visual lessons. This lesson is a design philosophy, not a law itself, so the 'not legal advice' framing is brief rather than load-bearing as it is in Lessons 4-5 -- it is still noted because the lesson references GDPR Article 25's actual text. All seven principle names and the Article 25 language are drawn from Cavoukian's own published framework and GDPR's own text, not invented.
